players.product: 22/28nm and mature-node logic foundry; silicon interposers

connects_to.relationship: mature-node foundry wafer capacity for Faraday's ASIC / MCU business (Faraday's IP is built on UMC processes)

contracts.signal: UMC's 20-F names Faraday Technology and Silicon Integrated Systems as the major related fabless design companies it provides foundry services to, with sales prices set through arms-length negotiation and mutual agreement in reference to market conditions; foundry services to these two companies generated NT$4,387 million (US$140 million) of UMC's operating revenues in 2025, against NT$3,611 million in 2024 and NT$3,022 million in 2023.
contracts.value: NT$4,387 million (US$140 million) of 2025 operating revenues from foundry services to Faraday Technology and Silicon Integrated Systems combined

connects_to.relationship: silicon wafer supply (UMC 20-F names Soitec among the principal makers of UMC's wafers)

contracts.signal: UMC's 20-F names Soitec among the principal makers of its silicon wafers: UMC says it purchased a majority of its silicon wafers from Shin-Etsu Handotai, GlobalWafers, Sumco Group and Soitec, and that it has signed long-term supply contracts with its suppliers to obtain sufficient quantities of acceptable quality raw materials.
